caption: The drawing depicts two gray, metallic-looking objects sketched with pencil on an off-white, slightly yellowed sheet of paper. Both objects are drawn with shading to indicate their three-dimensional form and metallic sheen. The object on the left consists of a long, straight handle that attaches at a right angle to a broader section, from which a spoon-shaped head extends upward, and a circular, coiled loop curves downward from the main axis beneath the spoon head. To the right, the second object is positioned vertically and appears to be a front view of a similar or related instrument, with a flatter, rounded, disc-like top, a central screw or rivet, and a narrow shaft that ends in a slightly curved section. The two objects appear to be variants or different views of a specialized tool. The background is plain and unmarked except for a faint pencil measurement, some minor foxing spots, and a handwritten signature in the lower right corner.
title: Shutter Dog
